lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five vertical columns. Within the mid-flank, these blobs exhibit a semi-regular 2D spatial arrangement where each centroid is separated from its vertical and horizontal neighbors by approximately 1.5 to 2 times its own diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a rectilinear grid. The highest-intensity blobs are primarily localized within the darker geometric centers created by these intersecting light-gradient vertical stripes and horizontal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges follow a horizontal trajectory across the upper third of the flank. These features are defined by a sharp luminance step-function, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a localized shadow-gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a high density of small, stochastically distributed high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the grid-aligned blobs on the lateral flank.
